title: Shut Down for Five Years, Xiami Resurrects via AI: Alibaba Launches HappyShrimp for 30 Yuan
excerpt: HappyShrimp, developed by Alibaba's ATH (TokenHub) business group, has officially launched on the iOS and Android app stores, and has been updated to version 0.
content_html:
HappyShrimp, developed by Alibaba's ATH (TokenHub) business group, has officially launched on the iOS and Android app stores, and has been updated to version 0.2.14 on the App Store.

It is not simply a re-release of an old product; it is the third model product in Alibaba's "Happy Series"—the first two are the video generation model HappyHorse and the 3D interactive video model HappyOyster. Users can describe emotions, stories, or musical styles in plain language, and the AI completes lyric writing, composition, arrangement, and vocal performance in one go. It focuses on end-to-end full-song generation rather than piecing steps together, and offers two output modes, "Smart Lyrics" and "Instrumental," plus reuse features such as "Music Recipe" and "Make a Similar Track."

Pricing for ordinary users is quite modest: the standard membership in China costs about 30 yuan per month and can generate 150 songs, which works out to about 0.2 yuan per song; overseas plans start at $14.90 per month, with credit packs starting at $9.90. The store also offers credit and membership tiers ranging from 89 yuan to 1,149 yuan, giving heavy users room to upgrade.
